_comment: Architectural artifact for PP2. This is a representative Shuffle workflow JSON for the Tier 3 dispatch path. For PP1 the live demo runs against the Python sim at playbooks/shuffle_sim/; this file documents the SHAPE of the real Shuffle workflow that PP2 will import into a running Shuffle instance and connect to real systems (Twilio for clinician notifications, Wazuh API for telemetry adjustments, etc.). Field names follow Shuffle 1.4.x conventions.
name: Tier 3 Dispatch — Clinician Approval Flow
description: Triggered when the engine emits await_clinician_approval. Applies Monitored Mode immediately AND dispatches an approval request to a clinician. On clinician webhook callback, escalates to isolate_host or stays in Monitored Mode per FR-06.

actions.name: Receive Decision
actions.label: engine-decision-in
actions._comment: POST from engine when SHUFFLE_WEBHOOK_URL is set

actions.name: Component 1 — Deep Telemetry
actions.label: raise-log-verbosity
actions._comment: PP2: call Wazuh manager API to raise rule verbosity + enable PCAP

actions.name: Component 2 — Shadow Auditing
actions.label: start-baseline-diff
actions._comment: PP2: signal the shadow-audit pipeline to start a behavioural diff

actions.name: Component 3 — Zero Interference (assertion)
actions.label: assert-zero-interference
actions._comment: Positive assertion: explicitly records that no traffic was blocked and no configurations were locked. This is the safety story.

actions.name: Dispatch — Clinician Approval Request
actions.label: send-approval-sms
actions._comment: PP2: real notification via Twilio (or hospital pager). PP1 sim just logs the dispatch.

parameters.name: body
parameters.value: TIER 3 alert on $exec.asset_id. Proposed action if approved: $exec.proposed_action_if_approved. Approve/deny via the dashboard.

actions.name: Wait — Clinician Webhook Response
actions.label: wait-for-clinician
actions._comment: Workflow pauses here until the clinician responds via the dashboard. Sends the response to /clinician-decision on this same workflow.

actions.name: If approved — Escalate to Isolate Host
actions.label: isolate-host
actions._comment: Only runs when the clinician approves. Calls Wazuh's active-response to drop the asset off the network.

actions.name: Callback — Notify Engine
actions.label: notify-engine-clinician-decision
actions._comment: Always runs (regardless of approve/deny) so the engine's audit log captures the final outcome.
